parts.zh: W: 那么，迈克，你负责了 Cucin Tech 的创新项目
W: 那好。首先，恭喜你！看来这个项目非常成功
M: 谢谢。是的，我确实帮助 Cucin Tech 扭转了局面
W: 他们的命运得以扭转
M: 是的，是的，我认为确实如此
W: 创新是这个项目的核心吗？
M: 当然。如果这么说听起来不至于太老套的话
W: 就不能停下来闻闻玫瑰花吗？
M: 这个嘛，我会在个人生活中这么做
W: 那么，战略创新究竟是什么？

items.stem: What seems to have been very successful according to the woman speaker?

choices.text: The project the man managed at Cucin Tech.
choices.zh: 该男士在 Cucin Tech 管理的项目。

choices.text: The updating of technology at Cucin Tech.
choices.zh: Cucin Tech 的技术更新。

choices.text: The man's switch to a new career.
choices.zh: 该男士转换到新职业。

choices.text: The restructuring of her company.
choices.zh: 她公司的重组。

items.stem: What did the company lack before the man's scheme was implemented?

choices.text: Talented personnel.
choices.zh: 有才能的人员。

choices.text: Strategic innovation.
choices.zh: 战略创新。

choices.text: Competitive products.
choices.zh: 有竞争力的产品。

choices.text: Effective promotion.
choices.zh: 有效的推广。

items.stem: What does the man say he should do in his business?

choices.text: Expand the market.
choices.zh: 拓展市场。

choices.text: Recruit more talents.
choices.zh: 招募更多人才。

choices.text: Innovate constantly.
choices.zh: 不断创新。

choices.text: Watch out for his competitors.
choices.zh: 提防竞争对手。

items.stem: What does the man say is the risk of innovation?

choices.text: Possible bankruptcy.
choices.zh: 可能破产。

choices.text: Unforeseen difficulties.
choices.zh: 不可预见的困难。

choices.text: Conflicts within the company.
choices.zh: 公司内部的冲突。

choices.text: Imitation by one's competitors.
choices.zh: 被竞争对手模仿。

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about?

choices.text: The job of an interpreter.
choices.zh: 口译员的工作。

choices.text: The stress felt by professionals.
choices.zh: 专业人士感受到的压力。

choices.text: The importance of language proficiency.
choices.zh: 语言熟练程度的重要性。

choices.text: The best way to effective communication.
choices.zh: 有效沟通的最佳方式。

items.stem: What does the man think of Dana's profession?

choices.text: Promising.
choices.zh: 有前途的。

choices.text: Admirable.
choices.zh: 令人钦佩的。

choices.text: Rewarding.
choices.zh: 有回报的。

choices.text: Meaningful.
choices.zh: 有意义的。

items.stem: What does Dana say about the interpreters she knows?

choices.text: They all have a strong interest in language.
choices.zh: 他们都对语言有浓厚的兴趣。

choices.text: They all have professional qualifications.
choices.zh: 他们都有专业资格。

choices.text: They have all passed language proficiency tests.
choices.zh: 他们都通过了语言水平测试。

choices.text: They have all studied cross-cultural differences.
choices.zh: 他们都学习过跨文化差异。

items.stem: What do most interpreters think of consecutive interpreting?

choices.text: It requires a much larger vocabulary.
choices.zh: 它需要更大的词汇量。

choices.text: It attaches more importance to accuracy.
choices.zh: 它更注重准确性。

choices.text: It is more stressful than simultaneous interpreting.
choices.zh: 它比同声传译压力更大。

choices.text: It puts one's long-term memory under more stress.
choices.zh: 它给人的长期记忆带来更大压力。

items.stem: What is the long-held view about mothers' sleeping with newborn babies?

choices.text: It might affect mothers' health.
choices.zh: 这可能会影响母亲的健康。

choices.text: It might disturb infants' sleep.
choices.zh: 这可能会扰乱婴儿的睡眠。

choices.text: It might increase the risk of infants' death.
choices.zh: 这可能会增加婴儿死亡的风险。

choices.text: It might increase mothers' mental distress.
choices.zh: 这可能会加重母亲的精神压力。

items.stem: What do Israeli researchers' findings show?

choices.text: Mothers who breast-feed their babies have a harder time falling asleep.
choices.zh: 母乳喂养婴儿的母亲更难入睡。

choices.text: Mothers who sleep with their babies need a little more sleep each night.
choices.zh: 与婴儿同睡的母亲每晚需要稍多一点的睡眠。

choices.text: Sleeping patterns of mothers greatly affect their newborn babies' health.
choices.zh: 母亲的睡眠模式极大地影响其新生儿的健康。

choices.text: Sleeping with infants in the same room has a negative impact on mothers.
choices.zh: 与婴儿睡在同一房间对母亲有负面影响。

items.stem: What does the American Academy of Pediatrics recommend mothers do?

choices.text: Change their sleep patterns to adapt to their newborn babies'.
choices.zh: 改变自己的睡眠模式以适应新生儿的睡眠模式。

choices.text: Sleep in the same room but not in the same bed as their babies.
choices.zh: 与婴儿睡在同一房间但不睡在同一张床上。

choices.text: Sleep in the same house but not in the same room as their babies.
choices.zh: 与婴儿睡在同一房屋但不睡在同一房间。

choices.text: Take precautions to reduce the risk of sudden infant death syndrome.
choices.zh: 采取预防措施以降低婴儿猝死综合征的风险。

items.stem: What do we learn from the report?

choices.text: A lot of native languages have already died out in the US.
choices.zh: 美国已有很多本土语言消亡。

choices.text: The US ranks first in the number of endangered languages.
choices.zh: 美国濒危语言数量居世界首位。

choices.text: The efforts to preserve Indian languages have proved fruitless.
choices.zh: 保护印第安语言的努力已被证明毫无成效。

choices.text: More money is needed to record the native languages in the US.
choices.zh: 需要更多资金来记录美国的本土语言。

items.stem: For what purpose does Fred Nawusky appeal for more funding?

choices.text: To set up more language schools.
choices.zh: 建立更多语言学校。

choices.text: To document endangered languages.
choices.zh: 记录濒危语言。

choices.text: To educate native American children.
choices.zh: 教育美洲原住民儿童。

choices.text: To revitalise America's native languages.
choices.zh: 振兴美国本土语言。

items.stem: What is the historical cause of the decline in American Indian Languages?

choices.text: The US government's policy of Americanising Indian children.
choices.zh: 美国政府将印第安儿童美国化的政策。

choices.text: The failure of American Indian languages to gain an official status.
choices.zh: 美洲印第安语言未能获得官方地位。

choices.text: The US government's unwillingness to spend money educating Indians.
choices.zh: 美国政府不愿意花钱教育印第安人。

choices.text: The long-time isolation of American Indians from the outside world.
choices.zh: 美洲印第安人长期与外界隔绝。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about television?

choices.text: It is being utilised to teach native languages.
choices.zh: 它正被用于教授本土语言。

choices.text: It tells traditional stories during family time.
choices.zh: 它在家庭时间讲述传统故事。

choices.text: It speeds up the extinction of native languages.
choices.zh: 它加速了本土语言的消亡。

choices.text: It is widely used in language immersion schools.
choices.zh: 它在语言沉浸式学校中被广泛使用。

items.stem: How does unemployment insurance help the unemployed?

choices.text: It pays them up to half of their previous wages while they look for work.
choices.zh: 在他们找工作期间,失业保险向他们支付此前工资的一半。

choices.text: It covers their mortgage payments and medical expenses for 99 weeks.
choices.zh: 失业保险为他们支付99周的抵押贷款和医疗费用。

choices.text: It pays their living expenses until they find employment again.
choices.zh: 失业保险支付他们的生活费用,直到他们再次找到工作。

choices.text: It provides them with the basic necessities of everyday life.
choices.zh: 失业保险为他们提供日常生活的基本必需品。

items.stem: What is local director Elizabeth Walsh of the Bucks County Careerlink doing?

choices.text: Creating jobs for the huge army of unemployed workers.
choices.zh: 为庞大的失业工人大军创造就业机会。

choices.text: Providing training and guidance for unemployed workers.
choices.zh: 为失业工人提供培训和指导。

choices.text: Convincing local lawmakers to extend unemployment benefits.
choices.zh: 说服当地立法者延长失业救济金。

choices.text: Raising funds to help those having no unemployment insurance.
choices.zh: 筹集资金帮助那些没有失业保险的人。

items.stem: What does Pennsylvania state representative Scott Petri say is the best way to help the long-term unemployed?

choices.text: To offer them loans they need to start their own businesses.
choices.zh: 向他们提供创业所需的贷款。

choices.text: To allow them to postpone their monthly mortgage payments.
choices.zh: 允许他们推迟每月的抵押贷款还款。

choices.text: To create more jobs by encouraging private investments in local companies.
choices.zh: 通过鼓励对当地企业的私人投资来创造更多就业机会。

choices.text: To encourage big businesses to hire back workers with government subsidies.
choices.zh: 鼓励大企业通过政府补贴重新雇用工人。

items.stem: What did Pen Hadow and his team do in the Arctic Ocean?

choices.text: They measured the depths of sea water.
choices.zh: 他们测量了海水的深度。

choices.text: They analyzed the water content.
choices.zh: 他们分析了水的成分。

choices.text: They explored the ocean floor.
choices.zh: 他们探索了海底。

choices.text: They investigated the ice.
choices.zh: 他们调查了冰层。

items.stem: What does the report say about the Arctic region?

choices.text: Eighty percent of the ice disappears in summertime.
choices.zh: 百分之八十的冰在夏季消失。

choices.text: Most of the ice was accumulated over the past centuries.
choices.zh: 大部分冰是在过去几个世纪累积的。

choices.text: The ice ensures the survival of many endangered species.
choices.zh: 冰层确保了许多濒危物种的生存。

choices.text: The ice decrease is more evident than previously thought.
choices.zh: 冰层减少比先前认为的更明显。

items.stem: What does Cambridge scientist Peter Wadhams say in his study?

choices.text: Arctic ice is a major source of the world's fresh water.
choices.zh: 北极冰是世界淡水的主要来源。

choices.text: The melting Arctic ice has drowned many coastal cities.
choices.zh: 融化的北极冰已经淹没了许多沿海城市。

choices.text: The decline of Arctic ice is irreversible.
choices.zh: 北极冰的减少是不可逆转的。

choices.text: Arctic ice is essential to human survival.
choices.zh: 北极冰对人类生存至关重要。

items.stem: How does Peter Wadhams view climate change?

choices.text: It will do a lot of harm to mankind.
choices.zh: 它将对人类造成很大伤害。

choices.text: There is no easy way to understand it.
choices.zh: 没有简单的方法来理解它。

choices.text: It will advance nuclear technology.
choices.zh: 它将推进核技术。

choices.text: There is no easy technological solution to it.
choices.zh: 没有简单的技术解决方案来应对它。

items.stem: What is the new study about?

choices.text: The reason why New Zealand children seem to have better self-control.
choices.zh: 新西兰儿童似乎拥有更好自控力的原因。

choices.text: The relation between children's self-control and their future success.
choices.zh: 儿童自控力与其未来成功之间的关系。

choices.text: The health problems of children raised by a single parent.
choices.zh: 由单亲父母抚养的儿童的健康问题。

choices.text: The deciding factor in children's academic performance.
choices.zh: 儿童学业表现的决定性因素。

items.stem: What does the study seem to show?

choices.text: Children raised by single parents will have a hard time in their thirties.
choices.zh: 由单亲父母抚养的儿童在三十多岁时会过得艰难。

choices.text: Those with a criminal record mostly come from single parent families.
choices.zh: 有犯罪记录的人大多来自单亲家庭。

choices.text: Parents must learn to exercise self-control in front of their children.
choices.zh: 父母必须学会在孩子面前练习自我控制。

choices.text: Lack of self-control in parents is a disadvantage for their children.
choices.zh: 父母缺乏自控力对他们的孩子来说是一个劣势。

items.stem: What does Moffitt say is the good news from their study?

choices.text: Self-control can be improved through education.
choices.zh: 自控力可以通过教育得到改善。

choices.text: Self-control can improve one's financial situation.
choices.zh: 自控力可以改善一个人的经济状况。

choices.text: Self-control problems may be detected early in children.
choices.zh: 自控力问题可以在儿童早期被发现。

choices.text: Self-control problems will diminish as one grows up.
choices.zh: 自控力问题会随着年龄增长而减少。
